title: Use a Subcommand
question: Parse a simple subcommand named list.
code:
import argparse
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
subs = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True)
subs.add_parser('list')
print(parser.parse_args(['list']).command)
explanation: Subparsers are useful for command-line tools with multiple actions.
